title: People often wonder why some entrepreneurs have greater succ…

sents.en: People often wonder why some entrepreneurs have greater success than others.
sents.cn: 人们常常好奇，为何有些企业家比他人更成功。

sents.en: Is it habits, connections, luck, work ethic or any other behavior?
sents.cn: 是习惯、人脉、运气、职业道德，还是其他什么行为？

sents.en: I believe the key to success is willpower.
sents.cn: 我认为成功的关键在于意志力。

sents.en: Willpower is the ability to control yourself. It is a strong determination that allows you to do something difficult.
sents.cn: 意志力是控制自己的能力，是一种让你去完成困难之事的坚定决心。

sents.en: It is a behavior we are born with more than one we learn.
sents.cn: 它更多是一种与生俱来的行为，而非后天习得。

sents.en: However, it is possible to not only learn it, but also strengthen it with constant exercise.
sents.cn: 然而，我们不但可以学会它，还能通过持续锻炼来增强它。

sents.en: Willpower is just like a muscle, to keep it strong you need to constantly exercise it.
sents.cn: 意志力就像肌肉，要保持强壮，你就需要不断锻炼它。

sents.en: People with a great amount of willpower have the discipline to develop positive, successful habits.
sents.cn: 意志力强大的人拥有自律，能够养成积极、助益的良习。

sents.en: Even with an incredible amount of talent, without the discipline and motivation to create positive habits, it can be difficult to achieve success.
sents.cn: 哪怕天赋异禀，若缺乏自律与动力去建立积极习惯，也难获成功。

sents.en: Willpower and habits go hand in hand.
sents.cn: 意志力与习惯密不可分。

sents.en: It is critical to create good habits and take the actions necessary to stick to those habits day in and day out for greater success.
sents.cn: 要取得更大成功，关键在于养成好习惯，并采取必要行动日复一日地坚持下去。

sents.en: Almost half of our daily actions are part of our habits and not decisions, so once the correct habits are in place, you will automatically perform those tasks on a day-to-day basis.
sents.cn: 我们日常行为中几乎有一半属于习惯而非刻意决定，因此一旦正确的习惯就位，你便会自动地日复一日执行这些任务。

sents.en: The best way to create and stick to a habit is to have strong motivation.
sents.cn: 养成并坚持一个习惯的最佳方式，是拥有强烈的动机。

sents.en: It's easier to change your habits to lose weight if you have a health issue and you want to be around longer for your kids, or if your business is something you're passionate about.
sents.cn: 如果你有健康问题、想为子女多活些年头，或者你的事业是你所热爱的，那么改变习惯去减重就会更容易。

sents.en: Having a valuable outcome associated with a habit will help you stick to that habit permanently.
sents.cn: 让某一习惯与有价值的成果挂钩，会帮助你将这一习惯长久地坚持下去。

sents.en: The art of self-control is one that most successful individuals have mastered.
sents.cn: 自我控制这门艺术，是多数成功人士都已掌握的。

sents.en: Self-control enables you to avoid behaviors that don't contribute to your success and adopt those that do.
sents.cn: 自控能让你避开那些无助于成功的行为，转而采取那些有助成功的行为。

sents.en: Because there is a delayed satisfaction associated with self-control, it can be easy to get off track.
sents.cn: 由于自控带来的满足是延迟的，人很容易偏离正轨。

sents.en: However, if you work on sticking to those small positive habits one day at a time, it becomes easier to stay strong and achieve that delayed reward.
sents.cn: 然而，如果你每天坚持那些小小的积极习惯，便会更容易保持坚定，并获得那份延迟的回报。

sents.en: Once a reward is achieved, it is much easier to continue sticking to your habits.
sents.cn: 一旦获得回报，继续坚持习惯就会容易得多。
